test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Addiction of drugs proved __detrimental__ for his health.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Beneficial.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"detrimental"** means causing harm or damage. (हानिकारक)

 
 
• **Example: **Smoking is detrimental to your health.
 
 
 
• **"Beneficial"** refers to something that is good or helpful; it promotes a positive effect. (लाभकारी)
 
 
• **Example: **Eating fruits and vegetables is beneficial for your health.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'detrimental'** is **'beneficial'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Beneficial**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Impartial** (निष्पक्ष): Treating all rivals or disputants equally.

 
 
• **Example:** The judge was impartial during the trial.
 
 
 
• **Potential** (संभावित): Having or showing the capacity to develop into something in the future.
 
 
• **Example:** She has the potential to become a great scientist.
 
 
 
• **Differential** (अंतर): Showing or depending on a difference; varying according to circumstances.
 
 
• **Example:** The differential treatment of employees led to dissatisfaction.
 
 

20b:Tb81,

The correct answer is: Option 2</b&
